# ffmpeg / ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer

ffmpeg's own fuzz target `ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer` ([source](source/target_dem_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over FFmpeg (FFmpeg/FFmpeg at bbd37149).

No summary of this harness is recorded yet; its checks, if any, are listed below.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against FFmpeg at commit bbd37149.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Statements ([Statements.v](Statements.v))

| statement | in one line | status |
|---|---|---|
| `plain_halts` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `asan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `asan_ubsan_halts` | on every input on which the ASan+UBSan build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise), it exits with status 0 or 2 | open |
| `asan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan never fires; memory refused only when forced | open |
| `ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 16 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; UBSan never fires; memory refused only when forced | open |
| `asan_ubsan_agrees` | on every input on which the plain build is never refused memory for exceeding 2 GiB (a premise): neither build reaches an error and both have the same set of observable behaviours; ASan+UBSan never fires; memory refused only when forced | open |

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch ffmpeg` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer.plain` | 3,769,024 | `60c1ce0f83788157c9b918c04a83363f25540fac747ecd2de662e709fd4e971b` |
| ubsan | `ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer.ubsan` | 4,390,048 | `db69f31082bacf103232e5019549412b41559a0d06ae2bd48663529ddfa99d67` |
| asan | `ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer.asan` | 10,327,480 | `854623756fec140833a2c104a745cc362c390ea38d680d0bd476e8558582af8d` |
| asan-ubsan | `ffmpeg_DEMUXER_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 10,831,192 | `39a47cb2a29ffbc9304a1a068bb9fe26b929588b8b71e483f557f0dacb956536` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbz2.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbz2.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbz2.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libbz2.a` (a library from the build image), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
